findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_pricing, search_b2b_contacts · Private data: about_slsbmb_ai, get_pricing, search_b2b_contacts · Public sink: get_pricing, estimate_sending_engine, search_b2b_contacts, start_free_interview.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_pricing, search_b2b_contacts · Private data: about_slsbmb_ai, get_pricing, search_b2b_contacts · Public sink: get_pricing, estimate_sending_engine, search_b2b_contacts, start_free_interview

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
